saw_lines: Buyers of hair extensions compare length, color and attachment before they click, and they will not guess on any of them.
So the sale is won or lost in the first line, where unanswered questions send buyers scrolling past.
Your 28 live ads never mention shipping, while your shipping page answers it. Put delivery time in line one for new buyers and test three variations.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 30 Oct 2026
points: Your shipping page answers how orders arrive, yet 0 of 28 ads mention shipping or delivery. New buyers hesitate on timing before they click. Lead the next batch for new buyers with delivery time in line one, and test three variations.

None of your 17 written ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing firm to trust before clicking. Collect one figure, such as review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.

2 of 17 ads are creator posts run as brand ads. Viewers read the creator’s trust as paid promotion, so the warmth gets lost. Whitelist both posts from the creator account and cut three variations of each to test.
0 of 17 ads carry an offer, so a new buyer has no reason to act today. Give them one push, a first order offer or a bundle, and place it in line one of three new ads.

ads_1: Paid creative led by delivery time, a review count and whitelisted creator posts
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram, Pinterest, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube
